title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, delivering powerful new capabilities to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: We've introduced comprehensive file management directly within the editor, giving you more control to effortlessly upload, download, remove, and customize the display of your embedded content.

title: Introducing the Official Product Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to introduce our new public roadmap, providing you with a transparent view of our recent achievements, what's coming soon, and our exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Our enhanced checkboxes now offer effortless interaction, with a larger clickable area, improved drag-and-drop functionality, and a sleek, modern design that perfectly matches our updated interface.

title: Enhanced Real-Time Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with enhanced tools that make collaborating on content more intuitive and insightful than ever before.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Discovering and collaborating on shared ideas and quests is now simpler than ever, ensuring you always find what you need for seamless teamwork.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Get ready for a truly global experience as Noeko introduces robust support for a multitude of international languages.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: Noeko is becoming open source, empowering our community with unprecedented transparency, control, and direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Intelligent Graph View: Explore Your Knowledge Like Never Before
summary: Effortlessly navigate and discover new connections within your knowledge base using an enhanced graph view, now featuring powerful filters for tags, time, and shared content.

title: Precision Search & Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your knowledge with powerful new filters and sorting options, allowing you to save your precise searches as custom collections for instant recall.

title: Smart Previews for Connected Ideas
summary: We're introducing more flexible and interactive ways to view your linked notes, allowing you to structure your thoughts more naturally with rich content previews.

title: Noeko: Flexible Hosting & Premium Plans
summary: This update empowers you to deploy Noeko on your own infrastructure or choose from new cloud-hosted plans with enhanced features and flexible pricing.

title: Stunning New Themes & Refreshed Classics
summary: We're elevating your experience with a refreshed collection of beautifully designed themes, including exciting new options and polished classics.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Time of Day
summary: Get a perfectly timed welcome every time you visit, as we enhance our greetings to always accurately reflect your current time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Organization
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your tagged content by applying actions directly from the tag view, allowing you to easily remove, delete, or view items without extra clicks.

title: Unlock New Content Types
summary: Empower your knowledge by effortlessly bringing in and interacting with diverse content from YouTube, websites, and various document types directly into your unified workspace.
